Remove a thread's link from an item; item show lists the account and thread key

## Usage

```text
chainmail item unlink <id> <account> <thread-key>
```

## Examples

```sh
# item show lists each link's account and thread key
chainmail item unlink it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 work 18c2f0a1b2c3d4e5
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
